description: Get the history of an ENS name, newest first, e.g. 'When was nick.eth registered, renewed or transferred?'. Each event has its time, type, a one-line summary and its transaction. Filter by types (e.g. registration, renewal, transfer, resolver, record, migration) and a date range. Results come from an indexer and can lag the chain by a few blocks.

cursor.description: cursor from the previous page, to read the next one

name.description: ENS name as the user wrote it, e.g. nick.eth; normalised by the server (ENSIP-15)

order.description: desc (default): newest first; asc: oldest first

name: get_name_history

asOf.description: Chain time the indexer's answer reflects

cursor.description: Pass back as cursor for the next page; absent on the last page

at.description: ISO 8601 date and time in UTC

partial.description: Why the answer may be incomplete

title: Get ENS name history
